messages:
tara: Follow-up from the postmortem: persistent night noise from cache latency alerts. We need concrete owners, short mitigations, and a validation plan.

ben: I can take rule audit + split by cluster. My plan: list memcache/redis alerts, propose per-cluster thresholds, ETA 48h.

emily: I'll prototype a low-risk suppression flow for 22:00-07:00: route duplicates to #alerts-staging unless the incident rate exceeds threshold.

ricardo: +1. Suggest dedupe key = host|alert, per-host cooldown 10m, plus cluster-wide cooldown 30m to avoid thundering herd.

toncall-bot: Reminder: changes that affect paging require runbook PR in infra/runbooks.

tara: owners: ben -> audit + PR (48h); emily -> suppression prototype + test (72h); ricardo -> dedupe config + PD mapping (24h); tara -> dashboard + success criteria (tomorrow AM).

emily: suppression example (feature-flagged):
```yaml
- alert: cache_p99_suppressed
  expr: (
    histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, host, cluster)) > 120
  ) and on(host)
    (cache_latency_zscore > 2)
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Will run in staging behind flag.

ben: will do audit and include per-cluster baselines. Linking results here when ready.

ricardo: PD mapping: set dedupe key host+alert; add rule: if open incidents for host in last 30m > 0 then suppress page -> post to #alerts-ops.

tara: metrics to track: total_alerts/day (cache_*), night_pagers (22:00-07:00), uniq_hosts_alerting, pages_per_incident. Goal: reduce night pagers by 75% in two weeks without missing critical incidents.

oncall-bot: Auto: please tag @eng-sre on runbook PR.

emily: prototype pushed to staging, tests running, will post status EOD.

ben: PR draft incoming for the audit.

ricardo: implementing PD rules today.

tara: quick check-in Thurs 09:00 PT. keep updates short here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
